mode: Informed expert module review; prior contract, existing source bindings and material labels known before image viewing. Not blind user testing.
method: Physically viewed six original 1152x768 normal-view screenshots via view_image, one severe frame each. Four predetermined I14 diagnostic worlds and two available same-grade neighbors; gallery original source/continuity limits retained. No new game run, image transformation or audio playback/listening performed.

classification.spaceProjection: Top-down player and ground with broad shaded surfaces suggesting height, curved mass and intersecting planes; cone/radial limited illumination masks beyond the immediate actor. No inference about 2D/3D implementation from this appearance.
classification.imageLanguage: Hard stair-stepped silhouettes and discrete actor pixels sit over dense granular or striated material surfaces with continuous-looking light falloff. Broad colored masses carry composition; fine texture does not replace those masses.
classification.formMaterials: Curved red shell, wedged blue planes, rounded purple shoulder and pale coarse-grain surface are the visible primary forms. Green marked actors and small ordinary protagonist use a simpler pixel silhouette within the same limited light.
classification.colorComposition: Warm small player light is set against locally red, blue, purple or pale neutral surfaces; green/cyan intrusion is localized. Much of the frame is black. Focal readable space is usually immediately ahead of the player, with quiet text at the perimeter.
classification.motifEmotion: The recurring relation is a small warm-lit figure standing beside a partial mass too large for one view; local color/material changes preserve isolation and close-range uncertainty.

identity.finding: Red shell versus blue layered wedge versus pale granular mass has distinct shape/color relations. The two paired comparisons show local structural differences, but all-library identity and unselected seeds remain outside this review.

coherence.finding: Small pixel actors, bounded lamp field, localized cyan/green and dark framing recur across all six without requiring the worlds to share one gray palette.

maturity.finding: Large forms and contact light are resolved in these views. Fine dense textures on broad faces do not by themselves prove fiber/membrane material behavior; continuous movement and source-specific audio are needed to settle that impression.

gameplayFit.finding: Visible protagonist and near figures separate from the immediate ground. Collision boundaries from all approach directions, natural search readability under stress and withdrawal remain unverified.

preserve: Distinct material colors and medium-scale shapes rather than overall gray unification.
Bounded lamp field and large forms extending beyond it.
Localized intrusion color and restrained peripheral HUD without a center overlay.
